messages:
maria (AE): FYI — Avalon asked for a written capability matrix + a short POC plan they can share with legal/security. They want HSM/KMS details, on‑prem deployment options, and a throughput SLA for 10k reqs/min. Can we pull something quick?
ashley (Solutions Engineer): I can draft the matrix. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) will Avalon require air‑gapped on‑prem or just VPC/private deployment? 2) is the 10k reqs/min steady or burst?
devin (SRE): 10k/min continuous is heavy — depends on model size. If they're using a 13B open model and we run dedupe batching, we'd need a small dedicated cluster. For baseline SLA numbers I can put latency percentiles and cost ballpark.
samir (Security): Also need to confirm key ownership model. Do they require customer‑managed HSM (FIPS/HSM) or is a KMS integration sufficient? If HSM, we'll need an on‑prem key wrap flow and KMS proxy in scope.
maria (AE): Their RFP says "customer keys in HSM" in the security questionnaire. So assume HSM required.
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Ok — I'll mark HSM required. That changes POC scope: on‑prem package or private deployment with HSM peering.
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Draft plan I propose: 1) Delivery: capability matrix + one‑page POC runbook (2 weeks). 2) POC infra: Private deployment in their VPC with KMS/HSM integration (we provide deployment scripts). 3) Acceptance: 95th < 150ms for 512 tokens on 13B model or fallback to 7B variant. 4) Security: HSM key ops, audit logs, and on‑demand memory wipe documented.
maria (AE): Nice. Can you add pricing tiers? They want committed vs burst pricing.
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Rough pricing bullets: - Private deployment engineering fee (one‑time) - Reserved capacity monthly (commit) - Burst on top at multiplier. I'll put numbers but mark as preliminary.
devin (SRE): For the capability matrix I'll add rows: model support, quantization, batching, KV caching, network egress, latency p50/p95, SLA, monitoring hooks, audit logs, KMS/HSM integration, supported regions.
samir (Security): Add a row for compliance artifacts: pen test report (latest date), SOC2 status, data residency guarantees, and whether we allow offline audit copies. (They asked about FedRAMP in another thread but for now SOC2 + pen test should be fine.)
maria (AE): Attachment: I uploaded our starting spreadsheet here — please update: https://files.redwood-internal/avalon/capability-draft.xlsx :paperclip: (will share with customer after review)
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Uploaded a trimmed POC runbook as PDF: https://files.redwood-internal/avalon/poc-runbook-v0.3.pdf
devin (SRE): Quick sample config snippet for our private deployment (for ops):
```
cluster:
  nodes: 6
  gpu_type: a10x
  autoscale: enabled
  batching: dynamic
  kv_cache: enabled
```
keep this as example.
samir (Security): On HSM flow: we need to confirm HSM vendor (Thales/YubiHSM) and key wrap algorithm. I'll send a short checklist to legal for the AVALON questionnaire.
maria (AE): Customer timeline: they want vendor comparisons by EOD Friday and to start a 2‑week POC the following Monday. Tight. Can we meet that?
ashley (Solutions Engineer): EOD Friday is doable if we keep it high level. I'll produce the capability matrix and runbook draft today and tomorrow.
devin (SRE): I'll put together latency / throughput slots and a short note on required infra. Samir — flag me if you need extra logging hooks for audit.
samir (Security): Will do. Also need to see how long we retain system logs by default — ops will need to confirm retention policy.
maria (AE): Who's client facing for technical calls? I'll schedule a 30m call with Avalon for tomorrow 11am PST. Attendees: Maria, Ashley, Devin, Samir.
ashley (Solutions Engineer): I'll prep the capability matrix table like this (columns): Feature | Supported? | Notes | Required by Avalon? | Attachments. Will flag HSM rows and provide links to docs.
devin (SRE): Note on SLA: we can promise 99.5% uptime for Dedicated with reserved capacity and fallback policy. For Private deployments it's dependent on customer infra; we'll provide an SLA for our control plane components only. Put a caveat.
maria (AE): Perfect. Last ask from legal/security: they want a list of sample contracts for on‑prem HSM and a short description of our KMS integration steps. Can someone paste bullet points here?
samir (Security): Bullets: - Customer owns key material in HSM (no copy stored) - KMS proxy authenticates via mutual TLS to HSM cluster - Audit trail exported to S3 (encrypted) - Support for HSM rotate policy + emergency key revocation playbook.
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Pricing bullets added to sheet. I put a tentative one‑time eng fee: $40k, reserved capacity monthly starting $25k/mo (for the target throughput) + burst multiplier 1.8x. Mark as preliminary.
maria (AE): Great — I'll loop in contracts and send the capability matrix to Avalon after our 11am call. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: File uploaded: avalon-capability-draft-2026-03-21.xlsx (link: https://files.redwood-internal/avalon/avalon-capability-draft-2026-03-21.xlsx)
ashley (Solutions Engineer): Thanks all — I'll merge comments and share final by EOD tomorrow.
maria (AE): Closing note: keep bullets short for the customer doc. They prefer one page for features and one page for POC plan.
